author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
People says in the age of AI, executive is free, taste and judgement is what still matters.

It is a lie.

In the age of Fable and Astra, taste and judgement are cheap too.

The only thing that is truely scarce, how to turn tokens into money.

Paradoxically, how to turn human hours into money is also the most scarce.

Nothing changed

comments.text: Flip it. Money that doesn't inflate is backed by real output. If LLMs and robots produce real output, powered by atomic energy far more cheaply than a 20-watt brain fed on meat, why can't tokens back a universal basic income for everyone? Then people could play with LLMs instead of losing a race against them.
